question: I can’t find the tea I’m looking for. What should I do?
answer: Please visit the Special Order page and submit the product details. Our team will review your enquiry and get back to you within 1–3 business days.

question: Can I buy Dilmah tea locally in my country?
answer: Dilmah is available in many countries, but product availability may vary by region. You can check the distributor or contact details on the pack, or contact us at consumer@dilmahtea.com.

question: Why should I create an account with Dilmah?
answer: Creating an account lets you access your loyalty programme, view past orders, and receive updates about promotions, discounts, and new teas.

question: How fast will my order be delivered?
answer: If your order is processed under Fast Dispatch or Regular Shipping, it will usually be dispatched from Dilmah within 14 working days after placing the order.

question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
answer: Please contact orders@dilmahtea.com before dispatch. If the order has already shipped, we will ask the courier to reroute it, but any extra charges may apply.

question: My payment went through, but I didn’t receive confirmation. What should I do?
answer: Please wait a few minutes, then check your inbox and spam folder. If you still have not received confirmation, contact orders@dilmahtea.com before placing another order.

question: What payment methods can I use?
answer: You can use corporate credit cards, TruePay for Page expired payments, PayPal for insufficient funds, or contact your bank if your card is blocked or declined.

question: Will I be charged extra for taxes or duties?
answer: Prices do not include local duties or taxes. These charges are set by your country’s customs office and are the customer’s responsibility.

question: I only received part of my order. What should I do?
answer: Some orders may arrive in more than one parcel. Please check your shipment details and contact us if something is still missing.

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: Orders can be cancelled by emailing orders@dilmahtea.com within 2 days of placing the order, as long as the parcel has not already been dispatched.

question: My order arrived damaged. What should I do?
answer: Please email orders@dilmahtea.com with your order number and photos of the damaged items within 14 days of delivery, so we can check with the courier.

question: I see a “Page Expired” message. How can I fix it?
answer: Refresh the page or go back one step and try again. If the issue continues, contact orders@dilmahtea.com.

question: I requested a password reset but didn’t receive an email. What should I do?
answer: Please check your inbox and spam folder. If the email is missing, contact us before trying again. You may also need to whitelist Dilmah emails.

question: Can I send Dilmah tea as a gift?
answer: Yes, you can send gifts directly to supported countries. You can also add your personal message when you reach the Shopping Cart.

question: Can I personalise selected gifts?
answer: Yes, selected presenters can be engraved with a name or company name. Character limits apply, and a small fee may be charged unless there is an active promotion.

question: Can I order larger quantities for my business?
answer: Yes. For larger orders or custom quotes, please contact orders@dilmahtea.com.

question: Do you offer different flavours and formats?
answer: Yes. We offer many tea flavours and formats. For specific product format questions, contact consumer@dilmahtea.com.

question: Can I track my airway bill?
answer: Yes. Please log in to your account and view the tracking airway bill number. If the number has changed, contact orders@dilmahtea.com.

question: Do you ship to every country?
answer: We ship to many countries, but some destinations may have restrictions. Please contact us with your country and order details so we can confirm availability.

question: Which currency will I be charged in?
answer: You may view prices in several currencies for comparison, but final payment is usually processed in US Dollars using your bank’s exchange rate.
